outcome: Bacterial metabolic gene pathways (folate biosynthesis, butanoate metabolism)
cohort: The study included placentas from 320 women with term and preterm pregnancies.
finding: Among women who spontaneously delivered preterm, excess gestational weight gain (GWG) was significantly associated with an altered preterm placental microbiome, including decreased microbial folate biosynthesis pathways and butanoate metabolism, while obesity was not.
cross-section timing: At the time of birth, when placentas were collected
